Among them are nixfmt's nested, expression-scoped 'with lib;' lines, which LANG-07 does not bind (disko lib/default.nix:401, lib/binfmt.nix:30; C29). It also misses a file-scope 'with lib; let' (devenv src/modules/services/mysql.nix:6; C27). The adopt skill carries the narrower '^with lib[[:space:]]*;[^[]*$' form, so the two bodies drift (C14). The language.md owner should decide whether to adopt that form
